children: Lyell Immunopharma completed the technology transfer for LYL273 to its LyFE Manufacturing Center and updated the Phase 1/2 trial timeline, now targeting additional data and an End-of-Phase 1 FDA meeting in 2027.
Technology transfer of LYL273 to LyFE in Bothell completed after FDA review of improved process and analytical methods.
LyFE implementing improved manufacturing process to boost performance, capacity and support dosing with the new process.
Ongoing dosing aims to determine the recommended Phase 2 dose and an optimized safety management plan for End-of-Phase 1 discussions.
Additional clinical data and a planned End-of-Phase 1 meeting with the FDA are now expected in 2027.
